notes:
Top-line: evaluating Redwood Dedicated for latency-sensitive trading assistant + downstream analytics. Primary ask: guaranteed throughput and deterministic latency under committed GPU pool.

POC summary (Feb):
- Ran canonical trading-chat workload (bursty, short-context chat + reranking) against 6x A100-equivalent instances. Achieved p95 ~130ms, p99 ~340ms for 13B quantized model with prefix caching.
- Throughput: sustained 1.8k inference requests/minute during peak window with aggressive batching; sustained tokens/s targets still require reserved headroom.
- Failure modes observed: KV-cache miss storms during sudden model switches -> latency spikes.

Requirements called out by MerCap:
- Latency SLOs: p95 <= 150ms, p99 <= 350ms for chat endpoints; reranking p95 <= 200ms. "Can't have >200ms p95 for trading desk" (quote from CTO on 2026-02-10).
- Throughput guarantee: baseline committed throughput of 1500 RPS with 30% burst capacity for 60s windows.
- Reserved GPU planning: initial ask = 12x A100 80GB-equivalent with plan for autoscale to +4 GPUs for peak. Must support mixed-precision quantized variants.
- Reliability/fallback: cross-region warm-standby (NA -> eu-west), automatic traffic shift within 45s on region failure, deterministic routing by priority + cost. Model variant fallback: prefer Llama2-70B-8q when available; fallback to 13B-4q degraded-quality variant if saturation detected, with request-level signal to client about fallback.
- SLA: target uptime 99.95%, latency SLOs per route (penalties/credits for breaches), 1-hour P1 response, 4-hour production mitigation window.
- Security: must pass SOC2 Type II plus KMS integration (customer-managed keys), data residency controls for EU-subaccounts, audit logging for all model requests.

POC/POV artifacts: attached POC_Results.xlsx (drive link), raw Fireflies call notes (ff ids). Redwood Optimize recommended: KV prefix caching + workload-aware batching to save ~30-40% token cost while preserving p95.

Commercial/contract notes:
- Meridian legal redlined SLA around fallback credits and failover verification steps. Asking for a testable failover run prior to go-live (third-party witness possible).
- Pricing sensitivity: wants blended unit-cost target to be <= current managed provider (approx target $0.017/token-equivalent for heavy reranking workloads).

Stated blockers: "Need final SLA language on cross-region failover and model fallback guarantees; security questionnaire 90% complete; budget approval in mid-March."
